takeaways: Prop plays went 33-28 (+2.75 units) in week 4.
Every-game spread picks went 5-9-2. Most are tiny gaps, so about half is expected.
Best prop type this season: Anytime TD, Over (9-26, +22.13 units). These are long-shot odds, so a few hits swing the total. Likely luck at this sample.
Weakest: Receiving yards, Under (38-48, -14.04 units). Worth avoiding until it turns.
Closing lines: 2 picks beat the close, 2 were worse, 12 didn't move.
Season sample is still small (61 prop plays). Judge the model after 100+.
